transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been really stuck on this feeling that people at work, and even some of the vendors, are tracking what I buy. Like they’re watching my orders and messing with the launch numbers so I end up looking stupid. My supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove that’s happening, but I still can’t shake it.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that others don’t hear or see?

Yeah… sometimes I hear a man’s voice, like it’s right behind me. It’ll happen in the stockroom or when I’m driving back from a vendor meeting. It says things like, “Move faster, Scott,” or it laughs at the stuff I picked. But when I turn around, nobody’s there.
Have you ever had any other unusual experiences where you felt like things were not real, or you saw or heard something that others didn’t seem to notice?

Mostly it’s that voice I mentioned. Like I’ll be in the stockroom or driving back from a vendor meeting, and it feels like a man is right behind me saying, “Move faster, Scott,” or laughing at what I picked. I turn around and there’s nobody there.
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that others might find unusual or hard to understand, that you feel strongly are true even if no one else agrees with you?

Yeah. I know it probably sounds strange, but I really believe people at work—and some vendors too—are keeping track of what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I’ll look stupid. My supervisor showed me reports that don’t really prove it, but I still can’t shake the feeling that it’s happening.
Have these beliefs about people tracking your purchases and messing with your numbers stayed with you even though there’s no proof, and how long have you felt this way?

Yeah… it’s stayed with me. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports and says there’s nothing there, I still feel like they’re tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look bad. I can’t really let it go. It’s been going on long enough that it’s a big part of why I came in.
Can you tell me more about why you believe people are doing this to you, and have you ever considered that they might not actually be against you despite how you feel?

I guess it’s because the numbers feel off, and then the way people act at work makes it seem like they know something. Like my buys get tracked, then the launch numbers don’t come out right, and it feels like it’s set up so I look stupid.

I’ve tried to tell myself maybe they’re not doing it, especially when my supervisor shows me reports and says there’s no proof. But I still can’t shake it. That’s really why I came in, because even when I try to be logical about it, it still feels true.
Have you ever experienced times when your thoughts felt disorganized or hard to follow, or when you had trouble putting your ideas together clearly?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think my thoughts get disorganized exactly. I mean, sometimes I’m stressed and it’s hard to explain what I mean, but I haven’t really noticed my ideas not fitting together or anything like that.
Do you believe that these people are targeting you specifically because of who you are, or because you’ve done something that makes you a target?

Yeah… I guess it feels like it’s aimed at me specifically. Like at work, with my buys and the launch numbers, it feels like people are watching what I do and then changing things so I look stupid.

I don’t know that I did one big thing to deserve it. It’s more like I’m the one they picked, or I’m the one they’re trying to make look bad. Even when my supervisor shows me the reports and says there’s no proof, I still can’t really shake that feeling.
Have you ever felt like people were out to get you or that you were being personally targeted outside of work or before this situation with your buys and launch numbers?

Not really before this, no. It mostly started with work — my buys, the launch numbers, and then feeling like some vendors might be in on it too. That’s the part I can’t shake, even when my supervisor shows me reports and says it doesn’t prove anything. It still feels like they’re tracking what I do and trying to make me look stupid.
Have you ever had any experiences outside of work where you felt like people were out to get you or that things were being done specifically to harm or embarrass you?

Outside of work, not really. It’s mainly been tied to my job — the buys, the launch numbers, and then I started feeling like maybe some vendors were involved too. Like people were tracking what I was doing and changing things so I’d look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me reports that don’t prove that, I still can’t shake it.

Even though your supervisor has shown you reports that don’t support your belief, do you still feel certain that people are tracking your purchases and changing the launch numbers to make you look bad?

Yeah. I mean, I know the reports don’t really prove it, and my supervisor keeps showing me that, but I still feel like it’s happening. I can’t shake the feeling that people at work — and maybe some vendors too — are watching my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look bad or stupid.
Even though you’ve seen reports that don’t show any proof, do you feel deep down that your belief is still completely true, like you just can’t accept that it might not be happening?

Yeah… deep down it still feels true to me. I know the reports don’t show proof, and I get that people are telling me that, but I just can’t shake it. It feels like people at work, and maybe some vendors, are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid.

Even though you’ve seen reports that don’t show any proof, and people have told you it’s not happening, do you still believe so strongly that people are tracking your purchases and changing the numbers that no amount of evidence or explanation could ever convince you otherwise?

I mean… yeah, it feels that strong. I know you’re saying the reports don’t prove it, and my supervisor has shown me that too, but I still can’t shake it. It really feels like people at work, and maybe some vendors, are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. I don’t know what would make me stop feeling that way.

How long have you been experiencing these feelings that people are tracking your purchases and messing with the numbers, and during this time have you experienced any other symptoms like seeing things, feeling detached from yourself, or having thoughts that don’t feel like your own?
It’s been about ten months, I think. The suspicious feeling about the purchases and the numbers has been going on that long… and the voice too.

Even though you’ve seen reports that don’t show any proof, and people have told you it’s not happening, do you still believe so strongly that people are tracking your purchases and changing the numbers that no amount of evidence or explanation could ever convince you otherwise?

Yeah… I know I’ve said it already, but I really can’t shake it. Even when my supervisor shows me reports that don’t prove anything, it still feels like people at work, and maybe vendors too, are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. I don’t know what would actually convince me it’s not happening.
